questions.text:
He swore he'd deleted every dating app off his phone.
I don't mean chat apps like Snapchat or Instagram, I mean actual dating apps.
Which dating app is still sending him matches?
questions.hint: Go through his emails, and don't skip the Spam folder. The match notifications show which app they come from.

questions.text:
So Tinder isn’t even installed on this device.
What device is he opening it on?
questions.hint: Dig through his emails — there's a login alert from a new device on that dating app.

questions.text:
I bet he's been paying for dating apps behind my back.
How many dating subscriptions is he paying for?
questions.hint: Go through his emails and his banking apps.

questions.text:
Two active subscriptions.
He swore up and down there was only ever one, and I bought it.
What's the second app called?

Hmm... his bio made me laugh when we matched, but I can't remember the words.
What did he write in his Tinder bio?
questions.answer: I can get rid of Tinder for you.
decoys: I can fix your Wi-Fi for you.
I can cook dinner for you.
I can plan a trip for you.
questions.hint: Check Photos for a screenshot of his dating profile.

questions.text:
Okay... Kelsey, Whitney and Tessa.
Which app did he meet Kelsey and Whitney on?

He claimed to be an entrepreneur.....
What does he actually do for a living?
questions.hint: Look at his income through the banking apps.

onboarding.text: Hi… Your name came from a friend of mine. She says nobody gets to the truth faster than you. I wouldn't be asking if this didn't matter.
onboarding.label: Paige

onboarding.text: Grant and I matched on Tinder a few weeks back. The first date couldn't have gone better — he listened, he made me laugh, and he told me straight out that I was the only one he was talking to.
onboarding.label: Paige

onboarding.text: Since then, though, something sits wrong and won't go away. Replies that arrive hours late. Evenings he describes without really describing anything… Maybe the problem is that it's all a little too perfect.
onboarding.label: Paige

onboarding.text: I've got into his phone. Going through someone's things isn't me, but I can't keep guessing. Is he being straight with me… or am I one of several?
onboarding.label: Paige

notes.body:
CARBONARA PASTA (easy version)

- 7 oz pasta
- 5 oz bacon bits
- 2 egg yolks
- Sour cream (one spoon)
- Shredded cheese
- Salt, pepper

1. Cook pasta
2. Fry bacon bits
3. Mix eggs + cream + cheese
4. Pour on hot pasta OFF THE HEAT
5. Add bacon

Done in 15 min 👌
